backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing events and computing Callaway results, including sorting golfers and applying chart‑based deductions and adjustments.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report container with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing all frontend files, covering components, state, styles, and Callaway logic.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Guide explaining where Callaway chart defaults are defined and how code edits interact with localStorage overrides.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes documenting restoration of a draft session without modifying production behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light/dark color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing navigation, event setup, score entry, Callaway calculation, and access to settings/admin views.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin panel component gating access via settings and hosting the Callaway chart editor.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Provides a UI for editing, validating, and saving 9‑ and 18‑hole Callaway chart data including grid values and column adjustments.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring event details like title, course, golfer count, hole count, and par, with validation before submission.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a detailed score breakdown for a golfer including gross, worst holes, deduction, adjustment, and net score.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Shows the Callaway scoring chart for 9 or 18 holes and explains how deductions and adjustments are applied.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print-optimized HTML document in a new window to export tournament standings as a PDF. Builds a styled table of results using event details and Callaway data.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Renders a leaderboard table with ranking, icons for top positions, and formatted scoring values.
Combines leaderboard standings, PDF export, and detailed per‑player breakdown into a complete results view.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfer score entry cards with name and hole score inputs, handling updates and gross total calculation. Ensures controlled input and validation for per-hole numeric entry.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates a golfer’s name and hole scores, ensuring required fields, correct count, and positive scores within bounds. Returns a descriptive error string or null.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Displays a settings page with an admin-access toggle persisted via state helpers. Provides UI for enabling admin features and a back button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes. Returns the current actor and its loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, stored identity loading, and status tracking. Wraps the app to supply identity to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend interactions, including fetching the latest result using the current actor. Queries are enabled only when an actor is available.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and a golf‑themed light/dark color palette, typography, and utility classes. Sets up base styling and font families for the app.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Implements Callaway handicap calculation using persisted chart data, computing gross, deduction, adjustment, and net scores. Handles fractional worst‑hole deductions and par‑based net score rules.
Defines Callaway chart entries for 9- and 18-hole rounds and provides lookup logic for gross-score ranges.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages loading, saving, and resetting edited and default Callaway charts using localStorage, including default grid generators.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Stores and retrieves admin-access state via localStorage.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer data, and Callaway scoring results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, plugins, colors, fonts, and animations for the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes project state, including feature requests for updating and promoting Callaway chart default values.
